title: Shopping care with TiC rates
summary: Research report: which patient questions the price files can answer, use cases, existing tools, product concepts, and what the crawler would need next.

title: Shop one scan
summary: Concept for the Everbetter app: nearby in-network sites ranked by what you would pay, each with our own care score, plus an assistant that answers questions from the estimate engine.

title: Rate my visit
summary: Concept: members report on their own care into their sovereign pod and choose whether a de-identified copy feeds the care score.

title: Check my bill
summary: Concept: compare your Explanation of Benefits with your plan's published rate, save the claim to your sovereign pod, and optionally share it de-identified.

title: Open enrollment plan picker
summary: Concept: estimate a full year's cost for each plan your employer offers through Captivated Health, using your own doctors' rates.
